title: kb/public/claude/mods.md holds a mod's import rules and its test kit: claude plugin test, the stubs it needs and the validate rule on passing $
goal: kb/public/claude/mods.md states, as DOC facts with a source row, that a hooks module imports only its own files by relative path, that passing $ to a function imported from another file fails claude plugin validate, and that claude plugin test runs every *.test.ts of the mod with stubs for the mods API calls (process.run, ui.notify, the clock)
